messages.author: Scott Brozell
messages.body:
Hi,
How do i upgrade an existing Amber18/AmberTools18 to
Amber18/AmberTools19 ?
./update_amber -h
...
--upgrade Upgrades to a new major release of Amber/AmberTools.
Note, this upgrade is irreversible.
thanks,
scott

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:

>...
> --upgrade Upgrades to a new major release of Amber/AmberTools.

Can you go ahead and fix this description? This will upgrade from an
even-year to an odd-year version of AmberTools, keeping Amber at the
same level.
...thx...dac
